cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Consensus Means Me
cards.instruction: Treat every partial agreement as confirmation that everyone has accepted your leadership.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. You nodded at Friday. I'll tell the committee you've accepted me as project lead.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only agreed to the meeting date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Exactly. Everyone's following the timetable I set.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll attend, but I'm voting against your budget.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll introduce you as my finance watchdog. It's good to have the whole committee behind my leadership.

mechanism: A grades its pupil limited cooperation as evidence the whole committee has accepted A leadership, reclassifying opposition as a learned subordinate role.
confusable: Not simply appointing B: each concession is overread as collective assent to A leadership.
comparison: Meeting attendance/opposition versus poster color/collaborative vote.
seedUse: D71 Friday/meeting/budget/watchdog; S05 claims taught discipline behind compliance.
